feeding_claim.verbatim: Our sheep are raised entirely on pasture and finished on grass without grain supplementation.

notes: The Allard family's ranch near Canton in Fulton County, which also boards horses. Checked the homepage, our practices, products and contact pages. The lamb is grass-fed and grass-finished with no grain; chickens are raised on pasture with non-GMO feed (an organic corn and soy free ration by request), and eggs come from pasture-raised hens on non-GMO, soy-free feed, with egg subscriptions waitlisted. Orders go through the Barn2Door store and the contact page offers free delivery within 10 miles of the ranch; visitors are asked to reach out before coming to the farm. The site also has a page recruiting egg producers, so some eggs may come from other farms. No shipping, markets or bulk lamb were found. The site says it is not USDA certified organic.
